newsitem.title: japan: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - April 28.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - April 28.

text.p: Following are some of the leading stories in the Japanese press on Monday, as reported by Kyodo news agency.
-- G-7 finance ministers, central bank governors open talks amid expectations of economic recovery in Japan, European Union.
-- Japanese, U.S. financial authorities agree to cooperate in exchange rate stabilisation efforts.
-- Hitachi, Fujitsu, NEC agree to set up firm to certify electronic trading on Internet.
-- Defense, Official Development Assistance face budget cuts in 1998/99.
-- Environment Agency to curb dioxin emissions.
-- Remains of rice plants dating back 8,000 years found in China.
-- Chinese parliament ex-chairman Peng Zhen dies at 94.
-- 59 percent of poll respondents believe Constitution's principles, value are materialised, respected.
-- Peruvian President Fujimori defends raid on ambassador's residence.
